purpose: Give Iced's text fields the system clipboard in the browser build, where upstream falls back to a dummy provider whose read and write always fail.
local_changes: src/platform/web.rs (new): on wasm32, write puts the text on the system clipboard with navigator.clipboard.writeText inside the key press, and read returns the text the page handed over from the paste event with set_contents, or the text last written
src/lib.rs: use the web platform on wasm32 and export set_contents there

Cargo.toml: js-sys, wasm-bindgen, wasm-bindgen-futures and web-sys for wasm32 only; examples and the example-only dev-dependencies (rand, winit 0.29) omitted so the fork resolves from the locked parent workspace; the original manifest is kept as Cargo.toml.orig
